summary.en: Its own Chromium on its own virtual screen: open the task's site or workspace pages, click, type, check results, screenshots, console and network errors.
summary.ru: Собственный Chromium на собственном виртуальном экране: открыть сайт задачи или страницы проекта, нажимать, вводить, проверять результат, снимки экрана, ошибки консоли и сети.

required.name: input.read
required.reason: to know the task the pages are checked for

required.name: display
required.reason: the browser runs on its own virtual screen, never on yours

required.name: network.task_services
required.reason: to open the servers this task started (http://localhost:<port>)

required.name: files.read
required.reason: to show the workspace's own HTML pages without starting a server

required.name: artifacts
required.reason: to keep screenshots and downloads for you

required.name: images.read
required.reason: to hand screenshots to the agent as images

required.name: ui.notify
required.reason: to show what the browser is doing

optional.name: network.internet
optional.reason: to open an internet address, asked per address

optional.name: images.analyze
optional.reason: to describe a screenshot with the Vision model

optional.name: images.original
optional.reason: to upload one of your attachments into a form

tools.name: open_page
tools.summary: Open a URL in the browser (a task server as http://localhost:<port>, or an internet address after the person allows it). Returns the page's title, URL, interactive elements with refs and visible text.

tab.description: Tab id; defaults to the current tab.

tools.name: open_workspace_page
tools.summary: Show an HTML file of the workspace: its folder is copied (read-only, protected files excluded) into the browser's sandbox and served there. Call it again after editing the files to see the changes.

path.description: An .html file, or a folder with index.html, relative to the workspace.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.summary: List the current page's interactive elements (ref, role, name, value) and its visible text, so an element can be addressed by ref.

tools.name: click
tools.summary: Click an element (by ref from snapshot, CSS selector, or visible text) and report what changed: URL, new text, console and network errors. Give expect_text to verify the effect.

expect_text.description: Text that must appear after the click.

tools.name: type
tools.summary: Type into a field (by ref, selector or label text); optionally clear it first and press Enter. Reports what changed.

tools.name: select
tools.summary: Choose an option of a <select> by its value or label.

tools.name: press
tools.summary: Press a key or chord (Enter, Escape, Tab, Control+A) on the page or an element.

tools.name: scroll
tools.summary: Scroll the page (to top, bottom, by pixels) or bring an element into view.

tools.name: wait_for
tools.summary: Wait until text appears, an element exists, or the URL contains a string; reports whether it happened.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.summary: Save a screenshot of the page (or full page) as an artifact and an image attachment; with question, the Vision model describes it.

tools.name: console
tools.summary: Console messages and uncaught page errors since the page opened (or since seq).

tools.name: network
tools.summary: Failed requests and HTTP errors (status 400 and above), including those the network policy refused.

tools.name: tabs
tools.summary: List tabs, switch to one, or close one.

tools.name: upload
tools.summary: Put one of the person's image attachments into a file input (asks the person for access to the original file).

tools.name: close_browser
tools.summary: Close the browser now (the core also closes it when the task ends).
